description: Desktop-Grade Web IDE with Virtual Workspace Asset Resolver, Event Bus Architecture & Quick Open
author: KeshavSoft
features: Virtual Workspace Asset Resolver: inlines relative CSS & resolves assets for 100% styled HTML live previews
Event-Driven Architecture (core/eventBus.js) with decoupled feature modules
Quick File Switcher Palette (Ctrl+P) with fuzzy workspace search
Workspace Folder Explorer (Open Folder via showDirectoryPicker)
Collapsible left file tree sidebar (toggle with Ctrl+B)
Multi-document tabbed buffer strip with isolated Monaco text models
Live Split-Screen Preview (toggle with Ctrl+\ or Preview button)
Compact 22px Studio Status Bar (Ln/Col, UTF-8, Spaces, Language)
Native File System Access API (Direct disk persistence via Ctrl+S)

shortcuts.quickOpen: Press Ctrl+P to fuzzy-search and open any file in the workspace
shortcuts.openFolder: Click 'Folder' to browse and edit an entire project directory
shortcuts.toggleSidebar: Press Ctrl+B to toggle the Explorer sidebar
shortcuts.togglePreview: Press Ctrl+\ to toggle the live split preview pane
shortcuts.toggleWordWrap: Press Alt+Z to toggle word wrapping
shortcuts.save: Press Ctrl+S to save active file directly back to disk
shortcuts.format: Press Shift+Alt+F to format active document
shortcuts.closeTab: Press Ctrl+W to close active tab
